description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

USAble Life is seeking a Web Developer I to support business needs by analyzing, developing, implementing, maintaining, and testing software applications. The role contributes to projects with system-wide impact and supports integration processes, quality assurance, deployment, and production troubleshooting.
Web Developer I building, testing, and maintaining software applications for company systems, including integration processes and production troubleshooting.

Responsibilities:
• Work with Business Analysts and Lead Developers to identify and document business requirements related to integration processes
• Conduct detailed analysis of defined system specifications
• Analyze, develop, implement, maintain, and test software applications supporting company systems
• Recommend practical solutions to processing problems
• Document product functionality
• Support quality assurance and deployment activities
• Troubleshoot production defects
• Participate in code reviews, provide feedback, and develop knowledge of software development lifecycle practices
• Assist with application planning, design, development, and deployment
• Maintain developed code in a revision control repository
• Communicate work status proactively to development and project teams
• Conduct code reviews to ensure application standards, conventions, and consistency
• Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Information Systems, with relevant coursework and/or experience aligned with the required skills
• Technical bootcamp experience may be accepted in lieu of a college degree
• At least one year of IT experience, or equivalent military experience
• Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL, C#, or other modern object-oriented development frameworks
• Experience with open-source tools such as log4net, NUnit, and NHibernate
• Experience with version control systems such as Git
• Experience writing SQL queries using database platforms such as Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, or Oracle
• Experience with software development or release tracking tools such as JIRA or Target Process
• Strong understanding of programming concepts, object-oriented development, secure coding concepts, and design patterns
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work effectively in a team environment
• Strong attention to detail
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Ability to complete assigned tasks within established time constraints
• Understanding of testing tools, unit and integration test scripting, and testing methodologies
• Experience with ReactJS, NextJS, or VueJS

Preferred:
• Coursework or curriculum focused on SQL and Microsoft .NET
• At least two years of IT experience
• IT-related experience in the health insurance industry
